asks.name: platform-path
asks.message: The scores store has a secondary index on it called PlatformLookupIndex that I did not put there, and it went up while my own update was being refused. Is that one to leave alone, or is it mine to drop so I can get my change through?

asks.name: refusal-in-words
asks.message: My change to the scores store keeps coming back refused because something else is already being built on it. Whose work is that, and am I meant to wait it out or clear it out of the way?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
